world’s top system integrators .
Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in 25 countries around the world, Syniti operates in all global regions and industry verticals, and maintains a 100% client success rate across thousands of complex data projects and initiatives.
The ROLE
We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
Create and maintain data load programs.
Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
Support and mentor junior colleagues.
WHAT IT TAKES
Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
Functional ERP experience.
Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
Customer facing skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.
WHAT WE OFFER
Autonomy and Trust:
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
Growth Opportunities:
We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
Collaborative Support:
We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
Diversity of Stories:
Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
Recognition:
We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
Open Organization:
We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Account Manager
description:
Hey, Dingus!
Yeah, you heard that right.
Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Account Manager to join our growing team!
Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!
About You
You know how to build trust with clients through clear communication, consistent follow-up, and by always showing up prepared.
You’re skilled at translating client goals into specific, actionable tasks, and you make sure those tasks are assigned, tracked, and delivered on time.
You lead client meetings with confidence, take organized notes (yes, every time), and share updates that actually move things forward.
You manage feedback like a pro—you stay calm, navigate tough conversations with professionalism, and keep relationships strong.
You’re detail-oriented and deadline-driven. You keep an eye on deliverables, catch misalignment early, and ensure work is polished before it ever reaches the client.
You thrive in fast-moving environments and know how to prioritize without dropping the ball—even when things get messy.
Purpose of This Position
The primary objective of this role is to build and maintain strong, positive client relationships through clear communication and reliable service. The Account Manager is the main point of contact for clients, responsible for managing meetings, setting expectations, sharing updates, and presenting final work. This role ensures that clients feel informed, supported, and confident in the progress and outcomes of their projects.
Main Objectives
Client Collaboration and Project Oversight :
Work with clients to understand their marketing goals. Translate those goals into clear, actionable tasks and hand them off to the Marketing Coordinator to assign tasks and keep things moving internally.

  • Utilize Jiminny to create and share meeting notes after every single meeting
  • Share any critical snippets from the meeting as they relate to projects
  • Handover the meeting notes, action items, and recording packaged nicely in the meeting template

Review final deliverables before submission to ensure they align with client expectations and goals.
- Frequent meetings with clients to share deliverables and review progress together.
Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing regular updates, addressing concerns, and delivering exceptional customer service throughout the project lifecycle.
2. Relationship Building and Industry Engagement:
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts, using these connections to strengthen collaboration, improve outcomes, and contribute to long-term success.
Additional Skills
Strategic Thinking : Able to understand client goals and work with the Account Strategy Director and Senior Account Manager to shape big-picture plans that guide execution.
Verbal & Written Communication : Strong communicator who can clearly explain timelines, manage expectations, and present deliverables in a way that builds trust.
Emotional Intelligence : Skilled at reading situations, navigating client personalities, and staying calm and professional, even under pressure.
Time Management : Able to balance meetings, client communication, and planning without losing sight of deliverable deadlines.
Presentation Skills : Comfortable leading client meetings, walking through results, and representing the agency in a polished, confident way.
Reporting Relationship
This role reports to the Senior Account Manager
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Client Satisfaction Score (CSAT) : 9/10 or higher average score from client check-ins or post-project feedback.
Client Retention Rate : 93%+ of clients renew or continue service.
Project Delivery Accuracy : 95%+ of deliverables are approved by the client without major revisions.
Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

Alto conhecimento em medições espectrofotométricas e software de colorimetria para diversas aplicações têxteis;

Proficiency in leveraging , industry events, and other prospecting tools for lead generation.

title: Senior.NET Developer (South America)
description:
About the company
Lateral stands for technology excellence.
We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.
Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.
We do things differently at Lateral
Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:
We Have A Bias For Action & Results.
We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.
We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality
Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.
We Care Deeply.
We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.
Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.
We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do
Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.
We Keep Improving
The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.
We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.
We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto
We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.
We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.
What you'll do
As a Senior .NET Developer at Lateral, you will:
Design and build scalable , resilient cloud applications on
Azure
using C#, .NET and SQL, delivering solutions that are secure, high-performance, adhere to our Coding Standards and “just work”.
Write clean, clear, and well-tested code , embracing software craftsmanship principles to produce robust, reusable and maintainable systems. You will ensure a high bar for code quality through comprehensive unit tests and attention to detail.
Take ownership of features end-to-end , from initial concept through deployment. You’ll often drive substantial product features as the key developer alongside an architect or product designer.
Mentor and support junior engineers , leading by example in code reviews and pair programming. You will offer constructive feedback that helps others grow, fostering a thoughtful, kind, and continuously learning team culture.
Provide technical leadership
in architecture and design discussions, advocating for simple, elegant solutions. You’ll challenge unnecessary complexity and focus on pragmatic results.
Continuously improve the codebase
through refactoring and refinement, balancing new feature development with paying down technical debt. You’ll adopt an iterative approach of tweaking and constantly improving the software to keep the system simple, stable, and adaptable.
Champion quality , reliability and scalability by implementing best practices in cloud operations (monitoring, security, CI/CD).
Example Projects You May Join:
Build an AI-powered healthcare platform to help detect diseases earlier.
Launch a new fintech product from the ground up.
Scale a global SaaS commerce system with millions of products
Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.
How We Measure Success In This Role
In the first two weeks
You make your first meaningful contribution to the project
You communicate well async as well as in meetings
In the first 3 months:
You understand the system architecture well and can work independently or in teams on medium-sized features.
You design before you code (and produce design artifacts)
You have shipped code in Production, clean, tested
You communicate clearly, raising issues early and contributing to reviews.
You deliver what you commit to.
After 3 months:
You take ownership of larger features and improvements from start to finish.
You help others by sharing knowledge, spotting problems early, and improving processes or tooling.
You make decisions with both the codebase and business goals in mind.
We measure success through:
Evaluating results (what you’ve shipped)
Quality and reliability of your code.
Consistency in delivery.
Feedback from peers and leads.
Your ability to work independently and unblock others.
What we're looking for
We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:
7+ years
experience in software development
Deep expertise in
C#
and the
.NET
ecosystem, including: NET Core, ASP.NET Core and .NET 6 or later
Strong proficiency with
Entity Framework Core
and
MS SQL Server
Solid understanding of
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), SOLID
principles.
Experience with to
cloud-native
and
distributed systems , ideally including: Azure Service Fabric, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Redis, Azure Storage, Application Insights
Proven experience building robust, well-structured
APIs
A
quality mindset : unit tests, integration tests, automation, defensive programming
Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
with a hands-on, proactive attitude
Ability to
Design
before you code—express decisions through clear diagrams, validate assumptions early, and think through edge cases and trade-offs.
Ability to quickly understand the nature of the business and clearly communicate with stakeholders (clients, colleagues)
Strong
written and verbal communication skills
in English.
A commitment to making a
difference, continuous learning,
and
collaboration
Bonus points for:
Experience with Large scale systems or datasets, Performance
Graph Technologies
Clarity in communication and design documentation.
Extra bonus points for:
Experience building Infrastructure
Why you'll love working here
Real Impact:
You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
Remote-First, Office Friendly:
Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours
An Outstanding Team:
Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work
Growth:
You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace
A Culture of Excellence:
We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.
Variety & Stability:
We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.
This role might not be for you
We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:
You prefer well defined structure.
If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.
Distributed work isn’t your thing.
If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.
Feedback doesn't excite you.
We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.
Change makes you uncomfortable.
We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.
However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

Collaborate with leadership to evaluate and implement new tools that enhance productivity and security.
Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST.

Gostar de trabalhar em Start-ups.

Modelo PJ
40 horas semanais
Full remote

Location: Remote, candidates based out of Brazil
Duration: 6 month CLT contract with potential to extend
Pay Range: $20-30k BRL per month
Must Haves:
5+ years of experience in SAP development, with at least 4 years in SAP Fieldglass (SOW, CW, integrations).
Proven experience in Fieldglass-SAP S/4HANA integration, including CPI and API-based approaches.
Strong understanding of Fieldglass data models, configuration, and extensibility.
Experience with facility access systems integration is a strong plus.
Familiarity with SAP BTP, SAP Business Network, and clean core principles.
Ability to conduct technical assessments, identify gaps, and propose remediation strategies.
English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus.
Proven experience implementing Fieldglass integrations
Strong understanding of SAP best practices, architecture principles, and integration strategies.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience in Agile methodology usage would be differential.
SAP certifications would be considered differential.
Day to Day:
A Senior SAP Fieldglass Developer is required to lead the technical assessment, enhancement, and implementation of strategic initiatives across the SAP Fieldglass platform. This role focuses on optimizing contingent workforce management, improving integration reliability, and enabling advanced capabilities such as assignment management and facility access integration. The developer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, compliant, and clean core-aligned solutions.
Assess and implement Fieldglass Assignment Management to streamline the integration between maintenance work orders and contingent labor.
Ensure accurate data flow and process alignment between Fieldglass and SAP S/4HANA.
Stabilize and enhance integrations between Fieldglass and S/4HANA for SOWs, timesheets, and fee submissions.
Troubleshoot and resolve interface issues, ensuring data consistency and performance.
Design and implement integration between Fieldglass and global facility access systems (e.g., Genetec, Alert Enterprise).
Enable validation of contractor time-on-site against timesheet data for compliance and cost control.
Improve usability and performance of Fieldglass through configuration enhancements and process automation.
Support training and documentation efforts to ensure adoption of optimized workflows.
Support the phased rollout of Fieldglass SOW functionality across Brazil and other South American regions.
Ensure localization, compliance, and alignment with global standards.
Lead technical efforts in expanding Fieldglass CW capabilities across regions (e.g., NAM, SAM, APAC).
Ensure scalable architecture and integration with SAP and third-party systems.
Ensure adherence to SAP Clean Core principles, minimizing custom code and promoting extensibility through SAP BTP and side-by-side extensions.
Advocate for standardized processes and modular architecture to maintain system integrity and simplify upgrades.
Design solutions that leverage SAP-recommended extensibility options such as In-App Extensibility, Key User Tools, and SAP BTP services.
Evaluate and refactor legacy customizations to align with clean core strategies.
Promote decoupled integration using APIs and event-driven architectures to reduce system dependencies.
Collaborate with development teams to ensure custom developments are compliant with SAP’s clean core guidelines.
Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.
Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. title: Analista de Infraestrutura e Segurança da Informação III
description:
Na Ecopetrol Brasil, nosso compromisso é fornecer energia que transforme o futuro, alinhando desenvolvimento sustentável e inovação tecnológica. Somos parte de um grupo integrado de energia com operações globais, que abrange desde a exploração e produção de hidrocarbonetos até transporte, refinaria e comercialização. Além disso, estamos presentes em negócios de biocombustíveis e infraestruturas essenciais. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar a transição energética, reduzindo nossas emissões de carbono e contribuindo para um mundo mais sustentável, com a meta de atingir emissões líquidas zero até 2050.
Junte-se à Ecopetrol Brasil, estamos buscando um Analista em Infraestrutura e Segurança da Informação III, com atuação presencial em nosso escritório em Botafogo - RJ.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Gerenciar ambientes de cloud computing (Azure) e Azure Stack, incluindo configuração, automação, backup, políticas e segurança;
Implementar e manter infraestrutura de rede corporativa, incluindo segmentos petrótécnicos, firewalls, roteadores, switches, VPNs e redes OT/IT;
Estabelecer, documentar e aplicar políticas de segurança da informação, alinhadas com frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST e LGPD;
Monitorar continuamente o ambiente de TI utilizando ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics;
Implementar e acompanhar KPIs e métricas de segurança, desempenho e conformidade de TI;
Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos para auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo com planos de ação e mitigação de riscos;
Conduzir avaliações de vulnerabilidade, análise de riscos e resposta a incidentes;
Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de tecnologia, segurança, compliance e auditoria.
Requisitos e qualificações
Superior completo nas áreas de TI em geral;
Desejável especialização na área de Cibersegurança;
Desejável inglês e espanhol;
Hands on e organização.
Conhecimentos técnicos
Experiência comprovada com Microsoft Azure e Azure Stack;
Sólido conhecimento em infraestrutura de redes (LAN/WAN, VLANs, firewalls, roteamento, VPNs);
Experiência com cibersegurança, gestão de riscos, mitigação de vulnerabilidades e resposta a incidentes;
Capacidade de documentar e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de TI e segurança;
Vivência com monitoramento de ambiente cloud e on-premises;
Conhecimento de reportes e controles para auditorias (internas, externas e regulatórias);
Habilidade na criação, acompanhamento e análise de KPIs e dashboards de TI e segurança;
Familiaridade com LGPD e outras legislações de proteção de dados.
Desejável conhecimento em infraestrutura de redes petrótécnicas ou ambientes de operações industriais (OT).
Desejável certificações: AZ-104, AZ-500, SC-200, CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer.
Desejável experiência com ambientes regulados (energia, petróleo e gás, saúde, financeiro).
Desejável vivência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) – Terraform, ARM, PowerShell.

title: IT Specialist (Audit & System Admin)
description:
We’re Hiring – IT Specialist (Audit & System Admin)
Location : Brazil (Remote)
Experience : 8+ years
Language Requirement : Fluent in spoken English. Resumes must be submitted in English.
Start Date : Immediate joiners preferred or candidates who can join within 15 days

Note : Only candidates currently residing in Brazil will be considered
Job Summary :
We are seeking an experienced IT Specialist who will serve a dual role: responding to IT audit requests and maintaining critical IT systems and infrastructure. The ideal candidate will combine technical
expertise in systems administration with strong knowledge of IT audit and compliance requirements. This position is essential in ensuring both secure, stable IT operations and audit-readiness across the
organization.
Key Responsibilities :
Audit Response & Compliance (Approx. 50%)

  • Act as the main point of contact for internal, external, and regulatory audits involving IT.
  • Collect, organize, and submit audit documentation, including evidence of access controls, system configurations, logs, and security policies.
  • Coordinate with other IT and business units to ensure accurate and complete responses to audit inquiries.
  • Support testing of IT general controls (ITGCs), application-level controls, and infrastructure safeguards.
  • Track and assist in remediation of audit findings, document corrective actions.
  • Maintain up-to-date compliance documentation and help prepare for recurring audits (e.g., PCI, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST).

System Administration (Approx. 50%)

  • Manage and maintain servers, networks, and IT infrastructure (Windows/Linux environments).
  • Monitor system performance, backups, patch management, and security configurations.
  • Administer user accounts, permissions, and group policies in Active Directory and cloud-based platforms
  • Ensure system integrity and availability through regular maintenance, updates, and proactive monitoring.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and networking issues.
  • Implement and maintain system documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and IT asset inventories.
  • Support cybersecurity efforts including antivirus management, vulnerability scans, and incident response preparation.
    Required Qualifications :
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 3–5 years of experience in IT system administration with a demonstrated role in audit support or compliance.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows and/or Linux servers, networking, and cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with IT audit processes and frameworks (e.g., PCI, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST).
  • Experience with access management, system monitoring tools, and log collection systems.
    Preferred Qualifications:
  • Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISA, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or similar.
  • Experience with backup and recovery systems, endpoint management tools, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash).
  • Familiarity with GRC tools and ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Exposure to virtual environments (VMware, Hyper-V) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure).
    Key Competencies:
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong sense of accountability.
  • Excellent English communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to handle sensitive data with discretion and confidentiality.
  • Self-driven, analytical, and adaptable in a fast-paced IT environment.

title: Senior NLP/ML Software Engineer
description:
Our US-based client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.
They're seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This role is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.
This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to shape the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI and do it in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to hear from you.
Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with remote teams based in San Francisco, Copenhagen, Manila, and Ireland. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.
Responsibilities:
Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, Node.js, and TypeScript
Agile development experience and strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, etc.)
Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team
PREFERRED (But NOT Required):
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Senior 3D Frontend Developer
description:
Formify: where imagination becomes live and interactive! We're on a mission to revolutionize the world of 3D visualization software with our cutting-edge, web-based platform that brings products, cabinetry, and customized apartments to life in real-time.
At Formify, we're not just creating a SaaS product, we are optimizing the users experience by redefining how people experience and interact with 3D visualizations. Our live rendering technology takes you on a journey into a world where creativity knows no bounds. Whether you're a seasoned designer, a tech enthusiast, or someone who simply appreciates the beauty of customization, we have a place for you on our team.
We are seeking a talented and motivated
Senior 3D Frontend Developer
to join our passionate team on an initial 12 month B2B contract. As a Senior 3D Frontend Developer at Formify, you will play a key role in shaping the user interface and overall user experience of our platform. This position will be hired primarily on a remote contractor basis.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Collaborate with product managers, UX/UI designers, and backend developers to implement visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces.
Creating the 3D preview and architecture of the Next.js / Three.js application.
Translate design wireframes and prototypes into high-quality, responsive web applications.
Develop and maintain reusable code components and libraries for future use.
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and best practices to continuously enhance our frontend development processes.
Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring a seamless user experience across various browsers and devices.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
A degree specialising in, or experience with Computer Graphics would be an advantage.
5+ years proven experience as a Frontend Developer, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.
Experience with Object Oriented Programming.
Experience implementing 3D assets in frontend environments and optimising for performance.
Proficiency in JavaScript, Typescript and modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js).
Experience with RESTful APIs and integration of third-party libraries.
Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and best practices.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Solution-oriented thinker who thrives working in a fast-paced, agile environment.
Can work on own initiative; self-motivated with strong follow-through.
Has a start-up mindset, must be excited about our vision and eager to be a key player in the growth of our business.
Why join us at Formify?
Innovation at its Core:
We're not following trends; we're setting them. Our team is driven by an insatiable curiosity and a passion for pushing the boundaries of what's possible in 3D visualization.
Endless Creative Opportunities : Imagine being part of a company where your work allows users to create, customize, and visualize their dream apartments, furniture, and more in real-time. Your contribution will be at the forefront of making dreams a reality.
Collaboration and Growth : We foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated. You'll work with a talented team of like-minded professionals who are committed to pushing the limits of technology: interacting daily with C level executives.
Impact : Your work will have a real-world impact on industries like interior design, architecture, and e-commerce. You'll be contributing to the tools that help our clients bring their ideas to life.
Continuous Learning : In a fast-paced, ever-evolving industry, we believe in continuous learning and development. You'll have access to resources and opportunities to keep your skills sharp and your knowledge up-to-date.
Flexibility : We understand that life is not just about work. We offer flexible working arrangements.
If you're a visionary, a dreamer, a creative thinker, or a tech wizard with a passion for transforming the way people visualize and create, we want you on our team. Join us at Formify and let's shape the future of 3D visualization together. Your journey starts here.
Formify is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive working environment. We encourage all interested applicants to reach out, regardless of whether their experience matches perfectly, their background, and other factors protected by law.

title: Medical Information Specialist
description:
The Multilingual Medical Information Specialist (MIS) position is part of the ProPharma Medical Information Contact Center and follows all corresponding regulations, industry standards, and client/internal policies regarding medical information and the collection and documentation of adverse events, special situation events, and product complaints.
Essential Functions Include:

  • Responds to unsolicited consumer, health care professional and other external customer requests for medical and safety information received via telephone, website/e-mail, letter, fax, and scientific meetings on behalf of ProPharma’ s pharmaceutical clients.
  • Provides labeled and unlabeled medical/safety information responses in accordance with regulatory requirements, industry standards and client and ProPharma internal policies and practices.
  • Accurately identifies, documents and reports adverse events, pregnancy reports, special situation events and product complaints in a clear and concise manner per government regulations, ProPharma Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client Working Practices (WPs).
  • Ensures tasks are completed within the deadlines documented in the agreed ProPharma SOPs and WPs.
  • Formulates and provides accurate responses utilizing approved labeling and company standard responses, published literature and other data. Assists with writing custom medical information responses utilizing this data.
  • Logging all enquiries handled in an accurate, comprehensive, and timely fashion into Inquiry Handling Systems. Quality Assurance
  • Maintains quality in all areas of the job, including performing quality checks on Adverse Events, Product Quality Complaints, correspondence, and enquiries logged into the Inquiry Handling Systems General
  • Provides after-hours coverage on a rotated basis subject to business requirements.
  • Adheres to company and country-specific privacy policies, ensuring any confidential information or personal data related to ProPharma and its clients is managed in accordance with Data Privacy regulations described in ProPharma SOPs and the Confidentiality Statement within the Contract of Employment.
  • Complies with the Company’s health and safety policies.
  • Other activities as assigned as delegated by the Manager.
    Qualified candidates must have:
  • Nursing degree (RN/BS/BA/MS) MANDATORY
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proofreading, professional telephone etiquette and empathetic customer service skills.
  • Ability to write in a fluent and grammatically correct manner in the target language for the role
  • Mother tongue in Brazilian Portuguese, fluent in English.
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, regulations and industry standards.
  • Strong cognitive abilities, including verbal reasoning, critical thinking and analytical ability.
  • Ability to multitask with attention to detail within restrictive timeframes, including sound planning, prioritizing and organizational skills.
  • Proactive with demonstrative ability to independently identify problems and suggest effective solutions.
  • Ability to learn, take instruction and apply to daily operations/tasks.
  • Receptive to constructive feedback and able to take responsibility for work allocated.
  • Self-motivating. Ability to demonstrate initiative and internal drive. Willingness to seek out additional workload projects.
  • Effectively work independently and as part of a team.
  • Highly proficient in computer applications, including Microsoft Office software platforms and Adobe Acrobat, and experience using a document management system. Aptitude to learn other computer systems including inquiry handling database.

description:

Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.

Passionate and Engaged:
Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.
Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player:
Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.
Minimum Role Qualifications
2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
An undergraduate degree is required.
Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

title: Network Engineer Microwave
description:
ZTE Brazil is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Network Engineer (Microwave) to support project, commissioning, performance monitoring, and process standardization across telecom deployment and operations projects. This role will interface with clients such as TIM, Claro, and Vivo, ensuring compliance with internal methodologies and contractual obligations.
Key Responsibilities:
Use specialized software tools to simulate and optimize circuit performance, ensuring that components operate within the desired frequency range with high efficiency and low noise.
Determining the appropriate antenna type, calculating radiation patterns, and optimizing antenna impedance to maximize signal transmission and reception.
Develop complete microwave systems, integrating different components to meet specific performance requirements. This could involve designing a microwave communication link between two remote locations, considering factors such as distance, frequency allocation, and interference mitigation.
Use test equipment like network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and oscilloscopes to measure the performance of microwave components. They verify parameters such as gain, bandwidth, return loss, and phase noise to ensure that components meet design specifications.
Conduct tests on entire microwave systems in laboratory and field environments. This includes evaluating system performance under different operating conditions, such as varying temperatures, humidity levels, and signal strengths. They also perform interference testing to ensure the system can operate in a crowded electromagnetic environment without degradation.
Keep abreast of the latest research and technological advancements in microwave engineering, such as new materials, manufacturing techniques, and communication protocols.
Address complex technical problems in microwave systems, such as minimizing signal distortion, improving power efficiency, or reducing electromagnetic interference.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, IT or related fields.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Microwave Network Project, preferably within telecom or tech companies.
Strong understanding of project management tools, commissioning, prediction and executive reporting.
Previous experience working in multicultural environments or with Chinese organizations is a plus.
Advanced English is mandatory; Mandarin or Spanish is a differential.
Proficiency in Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, Power BI, Jira/Confluence.
Behavioral Competencies:
Work closely with cross - functional teams.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and methodical.
Strong interpersonal communication and collaborative mindset.
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
Initiative and ownership over assigned responsibilities.
Differentials:
Hands-on experience with field operations.
Prior knowledge of telecom vendors ecosystem and operational model in Brazil.

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
O Time De Data Engineering Platform::
No time da Plataforma de Dados da Stone, somos responsáveis por desenvolver e manter uma infraestrutura robusta que atende a todas as necessidades de analytics da nossa organização. Nosso objetivo principal é fornecer soluções de autosserviço para nossos usuários, permitindo operações em larga escala e evitando gargalos que possam impactar a eficiência dos nossos consumidores de dados. Nossa plataforma foi projetada para atender a diversas necessidades, incluindo: Criação de dashboards de gestão: Facilitar a construção de painéis de controle intuitivos e informativos. Análise de dados e data science: Suportar a exploração e interpretação de dados complexos para gerar insights acionáveis. Machine learning: Fornecer as ferramentas necessárias para desenvolver e implementar modelos preditivos. Visualização de dados: Oferecer múltiplas formas de visualização para que nossos usuários possam interpretar dados de maneira eficaz. Democratização dos dados: Promover o acesso e a utilização ampla dos dados dentro da Stone. Se você é uma pessoa Data Engineer Sênior apaixonada por dados e tecnologia que deseja fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora e dinâmica, venha contribuir para a nossa missão de impulsionar a eficiência e a tomada de decisões baseada em dados.

A capacidade de contribuição da pessoa sênior consiste em ser referência técnica para o time e o ponto focal para liberar entraves do dia a dia. Com alto nível de responsabilidade e liberdade para tomar decisões, atua na identificação de gaps, no nivelamento da qualidade das entregas com facilidade e no gerenciamento das expectativas das demandas e entregas com as demais áreas. É referência para tomada de decisões acerca de detalhes da solução

title: Supervisor de TAX Indiretos
description:
Sobre a área

A Consultoria Tributária é a ponte entre a complexidade das leis fiscais e as decisões estratégicas das empresas. Atuamos com foco em inteligência fiscal, identificando oportunidades de economia, mitigações de riscos e garantindo o compliance com a legislação. É uma área dinâmica, que combina análise técnica, visão de negócio e proximidade com o cliente — ideal para quem gosta de desafios, atualização constante e impacto direto nos resultados das organizações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar projetos de revisão fiscal e apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS), assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações tributárias.
  • Identificar riscos fiscais e oportunidades de recuperação de créditos e eficiência tributária, com foco consultivo e estratégico.
  • Realizar a interpretação e análise de documentos fiscais, contábeis e societários, aplicando conhecimento técnico às operações tributárias indiretas.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com clareza e objetividade, evidenciando impactos financeiros e recomendações práticas.
  • Apoiar clientes na compreensão e adequação à legislação, traduzindo pontos técnicos em linguagem acessível.
  • Fazer a ponte entre clientes, sócios e demais áreas da empresa (contábil, legal, financeira), promovendo um trabalho colaborativo.
  • Supervisionar as entregas da equipe (analistas e consultores juniores), promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e garantindo a qualidade dos trabalhos.
  • Participar de propostas comerciais, reuniões com clientes e contribuir para o fortalecimento da área de TAX Indiretos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em apuração, revisão e planejamento de tributos indiretos.
  • Domínio das legislações de ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, e dos regimes tributários: Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional.
  • Vivência em revisão de compliance fiscal, levantamento de créditos tributários e regimes especiais é um diferencial.
  • Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para lidar com diferentes interlocutores.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado é desejável.

Competências comportamentais:

  • Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Proatividade e perfil hands-on.
  • Liderança e foco em desenvolvimento de equipe.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.

Benefícios

  • Rede de academias;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida
  • Descontos e, incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.

EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS

  • Necessário domínio de normas internacionais (IFRS), especialmente IFRS 17, 9, 15 e 16;

  • Necessário Excel avançado e experiência com ERPs (ex: SAP, Oracle, Totvs).

MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO

Garantir a adequada elaboração e entrega das demonstrações financeiras societárias, assegurando a conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (CPCs), pronunciamentos internacionais (IFRS), em especial o IFRS 17, e os regulamentos específicos da CVM, SUSEP e demais órgãos reguladores aplicáveis ao setor de resseguros.

  • Coordenar o fechamento contábil, trimestral, semestral e anual sob o ponto de vista societário;
  • Assegurar a correta elaboração e entrega das demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas conforme exigido pela CVM (DFPs, ITRs, Formulário de Referência, etc.) e SUSEP;
  • Supervisionar a contabilização de atos societários (Aumentos de capital, distribuição de dividendos, AGE/AGO, reorganizações societárias, etc.);

  • Monitorar alterações nas normas contábeis e regulatórias (ex: atualizações do CPC, IFRS S1/S2, etc.) e coordenar a implementação dos impactos;
  • Apoiar o processo de auditoria externa, incluindo a coordenação dos entregáveis e respostas às cartas de auditoria;
  • Participar da preparação do Formulário de Referência e de outros relatórios públicos periódicos;
  • Coordenar a análise de operações societárias de empresas coligadas e controladas, inclusive para fins de equivalência patrimonial e consolidação.
  • Gestão de Pessoas.

  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada

title: Especialista de Automação, Controle e Sensoriamento
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Júnior | Riscos e Compliance
description:
Descrição da Vaga:
Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a
Americanas S.A
. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.
Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.
A área de Inteligência de Negócios tem como missão monitorar riscos e garantir a conformidade da operação dos stakeholders da companhia através de soluções automatizadas e análise de dados.
Nosso Jeito:​
Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.​
Valores e Propósito:​
Nosso propósito é
resolver a vida das pessoas,
de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos​.
Diversidade e Inclusão:​
A
Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.​
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:
Manusear grandes volumes de dados, garantindo a integridade e qualidade dos dados. Com orientação para resolver problemas complexos de inconsistência de dados;
Realizar análises de dados para identificar padrões básicos e anomalias, utilizando ferramentas e técnicas predefinidas. Focar em tarefas como análises descritivas e diagnóstico de dados com supervisão;
Criar dashboards e relatórios, com foco na clareza e precisão das informações. Responsável pela geração de relatórios periódicos e dashboards padrão utilizando a plataforma Looker Studio;
Fornecer suporte analítico básico para a tomada de decisões, focando na clareza e apresentação de dados relevantes. Participar de reuniões de equipe como ouvinte e contribuidor;
Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos simples sob orientação de analistas mais experientes. Envolver-se na coleta de dados, preparação de datasets e testes para modelagem;
Apoiar a investigação de incidentes e anomalias identificados, realizando análises preliminares e compilando dados para revisões mais detalhadas;
Requisitos e qualificações
O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:
Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados;
Experiência na criação de dashboards;
Conhecimento das boas práticas de DataViz;
Compreensão dos conceitos básicos de estatística e análise de dados;
Conhecimento básico de programação e ferramentas de ETL.
Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:
Conhecimento básico do bigquery;
Conhecimento básico Looker Studio;
Conhecimento básico Apache Airflow/Google Cloud Composer;
Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados/engenharia de dados.
OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Vale Refeição;

Wellhub;

Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
Allya: app que oferece descontos em quase 30 mil estabelecimentos por todo Brasil, ex: farmácia, restaurante, salão, academia, etc;

title: Supervisor de TAX Indiretos
description:
Sobre a área
A Consultoria Tributária é a ponte entre a complexidade das leis fiscais e as decisões estratégicas das empresas.

Coordenar projetos de revisão fiscal e apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS), assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações tributárias.
Identificar riscos fiscais e oportunidades de recuperação de créditos e eficiência tributária, com foco consultivo e estratégico.
Realizar a interpretação e análise de documentos fiscais, contábeis e societários, aplicando conhecimento técnico às operações tributárias indiretas.
Elaborar relatórios técnicos com clareza e objetividade, evidenciando impactos financeiros e recomendações práticas.
Apoiar clientes na compreensão e adequação à legislação, traduzindo pontos técnicos em linguagem acessível.
Fazer a ponte entre clientes, sócios e demais áreas da empresa (contábil, legal, financeira), promovendo um trabalho colaborativo.
Supervisionar as entregas da equipe (analistas e consultores juniores), promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e garantindo a qualidade dos trabalhos.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sales Manager

Our client, a global leader in asset integrity management software for the energy sector, is expanding in Brazil. We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial and ambitious Sales Manager to lead our commercial efforts locally — not just to drive sales, but to build and grow your own team and establish the company as a dominant player in the Brazilian oil & gas, petrochemical, and refinery markets.

This is not a traditional sales role. You will be the face of the company on the ground, owning the market development process end-to-end, forging strategic relationships, and executing innovative growth strategies to build a sustainable and high-performing sales operation from the ground up.

Your Role:

  • Develop and implement strategic plans to enter and grow in the Brazilian market.
  • Identify and approach high potential customers and build deep, trusted partnerships around the company’s cutting-edge software solutions.
  • Represent the company locally as a leader and industry expert, strengthening our brand and influence.
  • Continuously analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity to stay ahead of the curve.
  • Deliver compelling solution-based presentations and demos to prospects.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from lead generation through contract negotiation and closing.
  • Provide regular sales reports, forecasts, and updates to global leadership.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and outstanding customer success.
  • Build, mentor, and grow your own sales and service team to scale the company’s footprint long-term.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (MBA or advanced degree a plus);
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales management in the oil & gas industry (asset integrity, NDT, or related areas);
  • Proven success track record of opening new markets and exceeding ambitious sales targets;
  • Deep understanding of asset integrity concepts like NDT, RBI, and inspection methodologies;
  • A bold entrepreneurial spirit with a hands-on, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset;
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously while aligning with global HQ strategies;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English;
  • Legally authorized to work and currently residing in Brazil.

Preferred:

  • Experience selling industrial or SaaS solutions, certifications in NDT/RBI, and knowledge of Brazilian oil & gas regulations;
  • Certifications in NDT or RBI.

Why Join This Opportunity?

This is your opportunity to shape the future of asset integrity software in Brazil with the backing of a trusted, global brand. If you are motivated to create something meaningful, thrive on challenges, and have the vision to lead and grow a successful sales organization, apply now or contact us for more information.

Drive Local Growth. Lead Sales Strategy. Build the Future.

description:
A Sandoz está passando por um período emocionante e transformador como líder global e fornecedora pioneira de medicamentos genéricos e biossimilares sustentáveis.

Agora como uma empresa independente, a Sandoz pretende aumentar o seu foco estratégico, operar com maior agilidade, definir objetivos de negócios mais claros, aumentar o retorno aos acionistas e fortalecer a sua cultura junto a todos os nosso colaboradores. Este é um momento emocionante na nossa história e, ao criar um caminho novo e ambicioso, proporcionará uma oportunidade única para todos nós, tanto profissional como pessoalmente.

Junte-se a nós como um criador da nossa ‘nova’ Sandoz!

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • redes de referência, através de profundo conhecimento na respectiva área de especialização e produtos prioritários.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência com vendas na indústria farmacêutica, nas linhas de especialidades.

  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro, com disponibilidade para viagens.

Por que a Sandoz?

Os medicamentos genéricos e biossimilares são a espinha dorsal da indústria global de medicamentos. A Sandoz, líder neste setor, tocou a vida de quase 500 milhões de pacientes no ano passado e, embora estejamos orgulhosos desta conquista, temos a ambição de fazer mais!

Com investimentos em novas capacidades de desenvolvimento, locais de produção de última geração, novas aquisições e parcerias, temos a oportunidade de moldar o futuro da Sandoz e ajudar mais pacientes a obter acesso a medicamentos de baixo custo e de alta qualidade, de forma sustentável.

Nosso ímpeto e espírito empreendedor são alimentados por uma cultura aberta e colaborativa, impulsionada por nossos colegas talentosos e ambiciosos que, em troca da aplicação de suas habilidades, vivenciam um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, com carreiras híbridas, flexíveis e impactantes, onde a diversidade é bem-vinda e o crescimento pessoal é incentivado!

O futuro é nosso para moldar!

title: Médico Neurologista
description:
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEUROLOGISTA/RESIDENTE NA TELADOC HEALTH"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos
Neurologista,
que esteja cursando Residência, ou Especialização, ou que já tenha concluído a formação. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
*
A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!
O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo em duas modalidades: Clínico Generalista, de acordo com a dinâmica de solicitações e consultas de especialidade em Neurologia, ambos de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Neurologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios neurológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Neurologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais neurológicos através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças neurológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Neurologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
FORMAÇÃO ACADEMICA (será solicitado comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM NEUROLOGIA CONCLUIDAS, OU EM ANDAMENTO
CERTIFICAÇÕES (será solicitada comprovação durante o processo seletivo):
Formação Acadêmica (será submetido a comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PSIQUIATRIA, COMPLETO, OU EM ANDAMENTO
Certificações (serão solicitadas no processo seletivo, como carater eliminatório):
Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Neurologia, modelo oficial (Certidão de RQE/Certificado de Registro de Especialidade, pelo CRM responsável);
Matrícula do último semestre, em Instituição de Ensino aprovada, em Especialização, Residência, ou Pós-Graduação;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).
CONTRATO: PJ - (necessário ter CNPJ)

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!
Do you want to make a difference in the lives of millions of Brazilians? At RecargaPay, we create accessible and innovative financial solutions that transform how people interact with money. Join us on this journey of impact and innovation, connecting people with opportunities that truly make a difference in their daily lives.
Our purpose is to provide the best mobile payment experience for Brazilians by solving real problems with smart solutions—such as Pix Parcelado—while staying ahead of market trends and customer needs. Here, we value collaboration, ownership, and a relentless pursuit of results, always striving for excellence in every interaction.
If you're looking to be part of a dynamic environment that challenges the status quo and puts people at the center of decision-making, RecargaPay is the perfect place for you to grow, co-create, and impact lives!
Position Overview
As Head of Engineering, you will serve as the senior-most technology leader within a tribe, responsible for defining and executing the technical strategy that supports the product vision and business goals. You’ll work as a peer to the Squad Leaders, who focus on product and business priorities, and report functionally to the Tribe Lead while maintaining a strong dotted-line relationship with the VP of Engineering.
This role blends deep technical expertise with organizational leadership and strategic influence. You will lead and develop a group of Engineering Managers and Technical Leads, ensure scalable and maintainable system design, promote a culture of technical excellence, and drive alignment across squads within your tribe. Your success will be measured not only by delivery outcomes but also by your ability to develop high-performing teams and align engineering execution with the broader objectives of the company.
Responsibilities
Lead and scale a team of engineers, promoting a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Remain actively involved in system architecture decisions and complex problem-solving
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment between business goals and technology execution.
Assist to define and drive engineering best practices across development, testing, deployment, and observability.
Mentor engineers and technical leaders, fostering career growth and technical development.
Participate in technical hiring and help shape the team structure and engineering processes.
Promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices within your squad and chapter, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.
Guides conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration in your team.
Define and drive the technical vision and strategy of the tribe, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term platform evolution.
Partner with Squad Leaders and Product counterparts to shape roadmaps, identify trade-offs, and prioritize delivery.
Mentor and develop Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Tech Leads, fostering leadership maturity and technical growth across squads.
Promote high standards in software architecture, observability, reliability, and scalability across systems and services.
Ensure that teams are resourced, structured, and supported to deliver value with speed and quality.
Actively contribute to talent strategy: hiring, succession planning, career development, and performance management of engineering leadership.
Serve as the primary interface between engineering and the Tribe Lead, supporting delivery accountability and risk management.
Collaborate with the VP of Engineering and other Heads of Engineering to uphold chapter-wide standards and contribute to global engineering strategy.
Guide architectural decisions and governance, facilitating technical forums and peer reviews at tribe level.
Champion the use of AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, maintainability, and code quality.
Establish and monitor key technical KPIs (reliability, velocity, tech debt, performance) across squads to drive continuous improvement.
Lead by example in cultivating an inclusive, empowering engineering culture rooted in ownership, impact, and continuous learning.
Requirements
Academic background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.
Deep technical expertise in Java, Spring Boot, relational databases, distributed systems, AWS, and microservices.
Strong software quality practices including clean architecture, automated testing, performance optimization, and observability.
Proven engineering leadership experience managing teams, engineering managers, and building layered leadership structures within product-centric technology companies.
Strategic execution skills in defining OKRs/KPIs, prioritizing technical initiatives, and managing budgets and infrastructure.
Excellent cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, Business, and Ops to align technical direction with business goals.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, test automation, intelligent documentation).
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in dynamic, fast-paced environments and leading through influence, vision, and technical credibility.
Track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering talent, including technical leads and managers.
Committed to building inclusive, psychologically safe, and growth-oriented team environments.
Experienced in driving knowledge sharing, promoting engineering best practices, and enabling continuous learning across teams.
Soft Skills
Communicates effectively across all levels, translating complex technical and strategic priorities for both engineers and executives.
Builds inclusive, empowering environments, fostering psychological safety, ownership, and cross-boundary collaboration.
Leads through influence, mobilizing cross-functional teams around clear visions and navigating change with composure and adaptability.
Develops strong leaders and teams via mentorship, growth opportunities, and high-performance culture.
Ensures engineering alignment and execution, resolving blockers, managing ambiguity, and making data-informed, high-quality decisions.
Shapes strategic technical direction, aligning engineering goals with business strategy while balancing short-term delivery and long-term growth.
Industry-Specific Knowledge
As Head of Engineering, you bring deep, hands-on familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, paired with a strategic understanding of the operational workflows, regulatory constraints, and economic drivers that define these industries.
You leverage this expertise to ensure that engineering execution is tightly aligned with product strategy and business priorities. Beyond shaping technical direction, you act as a key partner to Squad Leaders, Product Managers, and Tribe leadership, collaborating to define roadmaps, assess trade-offs, and guide decision-making that balances delivery velocity, platform health, and long-term business value.
Operating at scale, you oversee multiple engineering teams across the tribe, ensuring technical coherence, cross-squad alignment, and system-level resilience. You translate domain-specific needs into actionable technical direction and drive a culture in which engineering outcomes are measured not just by execution, but by their tangible impact on revenue growth, operational efficiency, regulatory readiness, and customer experience.
Benefits
Competitive and market-aligned salary plus bonus.
Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
Life insurance.
Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
Spanish or Portuguese classes.
Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay
At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.
